feeds.title: TechCrazy NZ Blog
feeds.description: The Tech Crazy news is your go-to source to read about the daily news from the tech industry. Our business model is simple. We source the best tech deals around the planet and bring them to you at sharp pricing.

feeds.title: Technology Investment Network Blog
feeds.description: TIN is the number one source of information on the New Zealand technology sector. Founded by tech entrepreneur Greg Shanahan in 1999, TIN has been taking the pulse of NZ's technology exporters for nearly 20 years, with a simple mission: to help facilitate the growth of the technology sector in New Zealand.

feeds.title: Sccop » Sci-Tech
feeds.description: Scoop NZ's Sci-Tech section gives insight into the latest innovation happening in the tech industry along with trendy news. Scoop aims to increase access to digital 'public interest' news media and foster media literacy by enhancing the ability of a diverse range of citizens to interpret, understand and use this information to inform robust debate, democratic choices, and meaningful participation in society and the economy.

feeds.title: Techoutlet Blog
feeds.description: Sign up to receive latest tech updates and special offers. We have a big range of lifestyle product, electronics, drones & toys. Our products are all designed to enhance your lifestyle in some way & seamlessly fit with you.

feeds.title: Techsoup New Zealand Blog
feeds.description: TechSoup New Zealand is a registered charity and not-for-profit organization committed to building stronger communities through technology. Our blog is regularly updated with news and other information that is relevant and valuable to the not-for-profit sector and which helps our fellow NFPs to improve how they work and stay up-to-date with what is happening. We publish stories about the big issues and the not-for-profit sector, helping our community stay informed about the big issues and opportunities.

feeds.title: RNZ » Media & Technology
feeds.description: The following section of Radio New Zealand covers the latest news from the field of technology. RNZ provides audiences with trusted and independent news and current affairs, a range of diverse programs, podcasts, and series both on-air and online in accordance with the Radio New Zealand Charter.

feeds.title: Wireless Nation Blog
feeds.description: Since 2005, Wireless Nation has been providing WiFi access to Kiwis all over New Zealand. Its mission is to help Kiwis have wireless access in every corner of the country! As a tight-knit team of technical experts, they all do their part by combining industry knowledge and expertise to find the best solutions. Visit their blog for All of the lastest News, and internet related Tips & Tricks from Wireless Nation!

feeds.title: FutureFive New Zealand
feeds.description: FutureFive NZ is a technology news website that is devoted to all things futuristic. It's a live news website with regular email newsletters. We aim to bring you the latest developments in drones, robots, car tech, home automation & digital entertainment.

feeds.title: NZ Tech
feeds.description: NZTech is the voice of the New Zealand tech sector. Its mission is to support a values-led, nationally connected tech community that is collectively lifting equity, sustainability, and prosperity for all in Aotearoa, by creating jobs, export growth, and impact through tech for good.

feeds.title: Beta Solutions NZ Blog
feeds.description: Beta Solutions is a full-service electronic product development consultancy based in Palmerston North, New Zealand. Since 2008, we have been privileged to partner with many national (from Auckland to Christchurch) and international businesses and entrepreneurs. An informative Blog where Beta Solutions share news, knowledge and insights on the latest developments in electronic engineering and product development

feeds.title: Inde Technology Blog
feeds.description: Inde is a New Zealand employee-owned and operated cloud-first provider of enterprise technology business solutions. We specialize in cloud-first enterprise technology solutions, with a focus on keeping our scope of service to our core competencies to maintain premium knowledge. Read Inde's latest blogs, news, and information about enterprise IT and cloud technology in New Zealand and Australia.

feeds.title: Summer Of Tech Blog
feeds.description: Check out the latest stories, resources, news, and views from the Summer of Tech crew. Summer of Tech empowers tech students to bridge the gap between learning and earning, by making it easy and attractive for employers to hire them. We help students build in-demand skills and connect with exciting, supportive, and growth-focused local employers to kick-start their careers.

feeds.title: IT Brief New Zealand
feeds.description: Dedicated to IT decision-makers at enterprise, corporate, and government organizations throughout New Zealand. These are organizations with more than 50 employees and an IT manager or CIO. IT Brief is a live news website with weekly email newsletters.

feeds.title: Tech Day New Zealand
feeds.description: Techday is a purely digital publisher that aspires to be the leading source of technology news globally. The grand central station for information technology news across New Zealand.

feeds.title: CFOtech New Zealand
feeds.description: CFOtech covers boardroom-level news and expert opinions bridging business and tech trends. It will cover systems and software being used to transform businesses; read by chief finance officers at Kiwi organizations with 200 seats or larger.

feeds.title: Management Magazine NZ » Technology
feeds.description: Management's focus is to inspire New Zealand's business leaders and the managers of today and tomorrow to succeed. Management is the officially recognized magazine of the New Zealand Institute of Management Inc. Stay tuned to learn more about the latest tech and digital innovations, news, updates, and more from Management here!

feeds.title: Idealog » Tech
feeds.description: Covering tech, design, marketing, exporting, and start-ups, the Idealog brand is about showcasing the transformative power of innovation and creative thinking. In-depth and practical with a focus on facts, people, case studies, and data, Idealog aims to be the voice of progressive business through a combination of inspiration and education. Read articles on tech in the following section of Idealog.

feeds.title: Ava Tech Blog
feeds.description: We help you spend more time on what makes your business uniquely you and let us make your processes work seamlessly in the background. We are a young IT consulting firm hoping to create and encourage an inclusive and supportive space for Women and minorities in the Tech industry. We strive to write content that is relevant and helpful for technical and nontechnical people.

feeds.title: Canterbury Tech Blog
feeds.description: The idea for Canterbury Tech was born in 2003 when a group of like-minded CEO's, business owner's and tech entrepreneurs connected informally to talk about ways they could help each other and support the technology and innovation sector in Canterbury. Since then, we have been the voice and connector of local technology companies and have seen the sector grow to become the second largest tech centre in New Zealand.

feeds.title: Smart Office Tech Blog
feeds.description: Smart Office Tech is New Zealand's sole distributor of the fantastic Xebec Tri-Screen, fresh in from the USA. This incredible piece of equipment is lightweight, highly portable, and offers multiple-screen convenience quickly and easily. The perfect solution for people working on the go stuck at home, or traveling for work.

feeds.title: Technology Systems Blog
feeds.description: David Stokes has 25 years of experience working in a wide range of industries and several roles, particularly Project Management, Product Development, and Business Process Transformation, scaling fast-growing organizations. His pragmatic and systematic approach seeks to find a simple, repeatable, and scalable way of working that suits the type of company, industry, and initial state of maturity and continues to evolve as the company matures.

feeds.title: Tech Marketers Group Blog
feeds.description: The New Zealand Tech Marketers Group (TMG) is a national community that supports marketers (working in SaaS or B2B tech companies or in technical marketing roles like automation, CRM & operations) with access to shared resources, mentors, training, workshops, and conferences. Read the latest articles, insights, and announcements from New Zealand's Tech Marketing community.

feeds.title: Techspace Consulting Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Techspace blog, a place you can come to read about trends in technology, career tips, and hiring the best talent. As technology specialists in the recruitment industry, Techspace builds the best-fit technology and digital resource capability for clients in a way that makes doing business with us easy.

feeds.title: NZBusiness Magazine » Technology
feeds.description: The Technology category in NZBusiness Magazine covers a wide range of topics, including Cybersecurity, Cloud computing, Data analytics, Digital marketing, and more. NZBusiness is a New Zealand business magazine that provides news, analysis, and commentary on the New Zealand business community. The magazine covers a wide range of topics such as business, politics, economic, and more.

feeds.title: Techblog
feeds.description: TechBlog was created by IT Professionals NZ to create a home for the latest news, views, and other information about tech and the IT industry in New Zealand.

feeds.title: Theta Blog

Founded in 1995, Theta covers a range of specialist areas and spans just about every industry in New Zealand. Theta's global partnerships with technology vendors will keep you well ahead of the game with the latest and greatest.

feeds.title: NZ Herald » Technology
feeds.description: The following section of the NZ Herald covers the latest news from the field of technology. NZ Herald brings you the news of the day from our dedicated online team and the top journalists.

feeds.title: Computerworld New Zealand
feeds.description: Computerworld covers a range of technology topics, with a focus on these core areas of IT: Windows, Mobile, Apple/enterprise, Office and productivity suites, collaboration, web browsers and blockchain, as well as relevant information about companies such as Microsoft, Apple and Google.

feeds.title: Softvire Blog
feeds.description: SOFTVIRE is a leading IT distribution company. The company yields a prime destination for various kinds of hardware and software including antivirus, Internet security and much more. Since 2005, we are serving our customers with the best prices and award-winning service, we provide before and after-sales, technical support, and training as and when it's required.
